title: Clinical Evaluation of the Efficacy of Femtosecond Laser-Assisted Anterior Lamellar Keratoplasty

groups.description: Femtosecond laser-assisted anterior lamellar keratoplasty (VisuMax; donor flap 220-370 µm, recipient cut 200-350 µm, host Descemet membrane and endothelium left in place) for anterior corneal pathology: keratoconus, corneal scars, lattice and Reis-Bücklers dystrophies, Salzmann degeneration and pellucid marginal degeneration (Results); 32 patients per the Results (the abstract gives 21 males and 10 females), St. Barbara Hospital, Sosnowiec, 2010-2015. Cataract surgery not stated.

decision: excluded: no admissible logMAR series (decimal means and a conversion of them)

exclusions.what: Table 2 row 'BCVA for distant vision' (decimal means)
exclusions.reason: means of decimal acuity are not admissible (protocol inclusion 2)

exclusions.what: Table 2 row 'BCVA for distant vision LogMAR'
exclusions.reason: printed next to the decimal row without its own test; the article does not state that acuity was converted to logMAR per eye for the analysis (Methods: 'Snellen chart with a logMAR'), and each printed value agrees, to the printed precision, with the logMAR conversion of the decimal mean in the row above, i.e. a conversion of the mean decimal acuity (protocol inclusion 2)

notes: Uncorrected acuity, astigmatism, intraocular pressure, endothelial cell density and pachymetry (Table 2) are mentioned here only.
No record is written: the study has no admissible series under extraction protocol 1.0.0 and the extraction brief.
